title: Support for women in business
summary: This page provides various resources and support options for women starting or running a business in NSW.
who_can_apply: Women starting or running a business in NSW

external_links.text: Online resources Access free online resources, including videos, podcasts and articles on a range of small business topics, to help get you started and grow your skills.
Running a business toolkit Explore a range of resources that support businesswomen who are starting or running a business.
TAFE NSW Women in Business If you're starting or running a micro or small business, you can enrol in subsidised online learning via the TAFE NSW Women in Business initiative.

internal_links.text: Personalised support Get ongoing, one-on-one support at every stage of your business journey. You can talk to us over the phone, in person or online.
Starting a business Learn how to set up your business, choose the right structure and apply for key registrations.
Grants and funding Find out if your business is eligible for a grant or other financial support.
Training, education and coaching Discover courses, programs and training resources to grow your business skills.
Networking and mentoring Connect with other businesswomen, investors, industry communities and local networks.
Business resources Websites and online toolkits to help women in business.
Mental health support Services and resources to support mental health and wellbeing in the workplace.

faqs.q: Where can I find ongoing, one-on-one support for my business?
faqs.a: You can access personalised support at every stage of your business journey.

faqs.q: What resources are available for women starting or running a business?
faqs.a: You can explore online resources, including videos, podcasts, and articles, or use the running a business toolkit.

faqs.q: How can I find financial support or grants for my business?
faqs.a: You can find out if your business is eligible for a grant or other financial support.

faqs.q: Do I need to enrol in a course to grow my business skills?
faqs.a: Discover courses, programs, and training resources to grow your business skills.
